rows.en: Zigrim Soldier E: "...Lord Grad, why did you send him to the rear?"
Grad: "Did you see his eyes?
Those weren't the eyes of a liar.
He can be trusted for now, at least. Besides...
Knowing them, they'll probably attack our supply train
at the very least."
Zigrim Soldier F: "!! Th-Then shouldn't we reinforce
the troops in the rear...?"
Grad: "No. We can leave that side to him.
And perhaps my worries are unfounded.
Like them, I can't afford a prolonged war.
This battle will decide the victor."
Zigrim Soldier E: "If I went to Cornel Village..."
Grad: "No. If you did that, there's no telling what Steinies
might do. Besides, I can't
involve you in my personal problems.
I don't want a long war because I'm thinking of what comes after.
We must finish before harvest season."
Zigrim Soldier E: "...Yes, sir. I spoke out of turn.
I'd be grateful if you'd forget it."
Grad: "...I'm sorry."
Zigrim Soldier E: "...Not at all."
Touya: "...York really is a natural fortress."
Fain: "Quite right, quite right. And the enemy would never imagine
we'd advance through a place like this."
Ciel: "...Quiet."
Celica: "She seems to have been in a bad mood this whole time."
Xiujian: "Perhaps she wanted to be alongside Lord Garyud
in battle."
Ai: "Hey... Don't you think it's time to be a little less
attached to your dad?"
Ciel: "...Mind your own business."
Ai: "What's that?! I'm saying this for your own good!
You're just weird, you know.
'Father this, Father that!'"
Ciel: "You..."
Aurelie: "...Stop it.
Taking out the supply train comes first.
Save the fight for later!"
Ciel: "..."
Ai: "But..."
Aurelie: "No buts!
If we drag our feet,
everyone back at the castle will be in danger.
Think about how much responsibility you're carrying!"
Ciel: "Ugh..."
Ai: "A-All right!
You just want us to stop, right?!
Come on, let's go!"
Aurelie: "Wait! Both of you, apologize to each other."
Ciel: "What?!"
Ai: "Why should I?"
Aurelie: "You're still such children.
You were both at fault this time. Admit when you're wrong
and give an honest apology. Can't you do even that?"
Ai: "...All right. You want an apology, right?
...S-Sorry about that."
Ciel: "I-I'm sorry too..."
Aurelie: "You don't mean it. Try again."
Ai: "Aw, come on. Isn't that enough?"
Ciel: "Exactly. Doing this is just a waste of time."
Aurelie: "Maybe you do think alike.
You're perfectly in sync."
Ai: "Oh..."
Ciel: "..."
Ai: "Heh heh heh..."
Ciel: "Heh... I went too far. I'm sorry."
Ai: "Oh, yeah. Maybe I went too far too."
Aurelie: "That's better. Come on, let's go!"
Fain: '...She really is like the boss lady.'
Touya: 'Yeah. But she's not even twenty yet.'
Fain: 'What?! I thought she was about twenty-five...'
Aurelie: "...You're being noisy over there."
Xiujian: "...So it's begun."
Ciel: "We're almost there. Is everyone ready?"
Fain: "Anytime!"
Celica: "It's beyond that mountain."
Touya: "All right, let's go!"
